DZA.note: Document states no rule or authority on AI harms.
Document states no government body using AI; AI is only a training topic.
Document states no sectoral AI tool.
Document states no AI model, dataset or computing built in the country.
Programme is for the general public, not civil servants.

facts.fact: Le Chiffre d'Affaires reports that the national 7-77 digital inclusion programme, launched in July 2026 with Algerie Telecom taking part, had held 40 online sessions for 1,166 participants and began in-person sessions for 600 people at Setif on 9 August 2026, with Annaba and Saida scheduled next.
